description: 12-EDO frozen baselines cannot detect the one-sided octave-class bug in calculate_harmonic_ratio. This fixture is the microtonal regression lock for a tool whose declared domain is 24 steps to the octave.
rationale: Fundamental C4 (60). C5-15c (71.85) is 0.15 semitones flat of an octave (oct_dist=0.15) and must count as harmonic. E4 (64) does not. Equal amplitudes → 2/3. The pre-fix modulo+isclose rule rejected 11.85 and yielded 1/3.
